overall: The AG found the committee violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing nonunion pay in executive session for an improper purpose and by failing to respond to a minutes request within 10 days; ordered release of the redacted portions and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee met in executive session for an improper purpose on Sept 5, 2013, discussing nonunion cafeteria worker and teaching assistant pay.
allegations.key_passage: Because there was no contract negotiation with nonunion personnel, this discussion should have been done in public view.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee did not release executive session minutes from the Sept 5, 2013 meeting in a timely manner after repeated requests.
allegations.key_passage: the Committee failed to respond to Mr. Boroff within 10 days, as required by the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Release the redacted portions of the September 5, 2013 executive session discussion of cafeteria workers and teaching assistants within thirty days of receipt of the letter.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
